order: Only old PR1/2/3 signal values examined; new SQLite schema, counts and timestamp bounds inspected before this freeze. New signal values and outcomes not yet read.
development: right 2026-11-05 00:00 to2026-11-07 15:00; existing two historical nights, not blind
primary_validation: right nights2026-11-07 through2026-11-11 and available daytime through11-12; lock before signal read; no holdout tuning
secondary_validation: left available 11-05..11-12, independent line transfer; no mixing of states or geometry
unchanged_core: original V51 cpp/h and all mathematical config; each group independently processes full baseline, learning, pooled history and correction

noise_evidence.statistic: lag1 correlation of past raw/residual increments
noise_evidence.sigma: 1.4826 MAD of past second differences divided sqrt6; proxy only, not truth

N1.prediction: last raw plus median of last3 slopes
N1.action: winsorize only recurrent isolated excursion beyond6sigma; unknown first events pass; persistent step releases next frame

N2.linear_ablation: past4 plus current real timestamp local linear endpoint, same eligibility and reset/budget

N3.common: independent original raw-input V51 shadow at current real timestamp; c=raw-cal_shadow, residual=cal_shadow
N3.residual_filter: same frozen N2 alpha-beta on statistically eligible residuals
N3.confidence: shadow modes ready, actual gate>0, all original learning points valid and no original SolveV rejection; reset residual history if unavailable/model-night changes
N3.preserve_common: project proposed increments on eligible learning subset into null(A_L^T); never spread correction to ineligible points; if rank/redundancy insufficient do not change learning points
N3.non_learning: eligible fit-only observations can be residual-filtered without modifying current learning coefficients
N3.budget: scale projected learning increments together to retain orthogonality and <=0.5sigma per point

B4: only after old-data B1/B3 each improve paired known-noise output sensitivity >=10pct median, no >10pct key LF/step deterioration, 1/3mm and ramp retention0.9..1.1 and <=5frames, extra nontarget response<=0.1mm. Otherwise skip; do not use validation to select combination.

synthetic_noise.distribution: independent Gaussian, same additive sequence across methods; whole stream includes baseline/history; paired within-method sensitivity, not physical error

waveforms: each YXJ or ZXJ name single1/3mm step
injection_position: before preprocessing, after02 learning for suffix tests; own complete preprocessor+V51 snapshot for every group; raw-source noise experiments rerun full history
